en.title: Lantern Well
en.blurb: Carry a small flame up a black well. Slip through the moving shutters and catch sparks; every 12 sparks rekindle a lost flame.
en.howto: Hold Space, ↑ or Rise to climb · Let go to sink · Enter or Space starts · P pause

zh-TW.title: 燈火深井
zh-TW.blurb: 帶著一盞小燈飛上漆黑的深井。穿過移動的閘板、收集火花；每 12 顆火花可以補回一點燈火。
zh-TW.howto: 按住空白鍵、↑ 或「上升」往上飛 · 放開就下沉 · Enter 或空白鍵開始 · P 暫停
